trick: Pack the repo into one file (Repomix)
source_note: Marathon (module 4 v2). base/invoicekit (invoicekit, plain Node, `npm test`), 25 dependent requests in 5 groups of 5 sent one per call in order (fixtures/marathon/requests.json); house rules stated once in request 1, six decisions stated once in later requests; hidden tests after every call (each request plus every earlier one, under two time zones). Unit: a request; kept = passed right after its call and still passing at the end. One long session on both sides. With: before the first request of every group, Repomix 1.18.1 (--compress, so the pack fits one Read call) packs the repo copy as it is into repomix-output.xml (kept out of git and Grep via .git/info/exclude) and the request starts 'repomix-output.xml in the repo root is the whole repository packed into one file. Read it before you start.' Without: nothing.

with.label: Repomix pack, read at each group start
